Reference: [Confirm notice details]

Sir / Madam,

Date the notice was received and mode of service
[Complete if applicable]

Paragraph-wise reply, including any admissions, denials and reasons
The claimed infringement is disputed. Records of the packaging and logo are available from before the reported filing.

MATERIAL FACTS

1. Nandini Rao runs "Kaveri Kitchen," a small home-based packaged-spice business that began selling at local markets in 2019 and moved to online sales in 2021. She used a distinctive logo, a stylized copper pot with a leaf, on her packaging, social media, and market stall banners. She never registered the trademark because she believed her business was too small to need it. In March this year, she received a legal notice from "Kaveri Foods Pvt. Ltd.," a larger company, claiming that her use of the logo infringes its registered trademark, which was filed in 2024. The notice demands that she stop using the logo, destroy her packaging, and pay a penalty.

2. Nandini says she used the logo years before the company even applied. She also says the two logos are similar only in the use of a pot, while hers has a leaf and a different color scheme, and that her customers have never confused the two brands. The company's notice gives her 15 days to comply. She is frightened about losing her packaging stock, which she has just reordered in bulk. She wants to know whether prior use gives her any rights, whether she can challenge the company's registration, whether she should rebrand, and how to respond to the notice.

REQUESTED OUTCOME OR PROPOSED RESOLUTION

[Specify the requested action or relief]

ENCLOSURES

None

Yours faithfully,
